body:
The deal marks PennantPark's 13th securitization and supports the fund's credit portfolio with long-term capital.

The New York-based asset manager entered private credit in 2024 by acquiring Avenue Capital's team and five funds with approximately $500 million in commitments.

The StepStone-backed transaction reportedly extends Blackstone's ownership of a loan portfolio from its Capital Opportunities Fund IV.

After an unsuccessful first attempt, Cox has come back to the table with an unsolicited bid valuing Class I shares at ~13% below their August 31 NAV.

"The Cox Capital Offer appears designed to transfer value from BCRED shareholders to Cox Capital and its investors," according to a Board recommendation viewed in EvergreenLink 's Notice Board.

The combined $25 million program prices ADS and ASIF shares at 14.6% and 13.4% discounts to August NAVs respectively, after both funds again capped repurchases.

Cox Capital Retail Secondaries Fund I is seeking up to $40 million of BCRED and HLEND at discounts to NAV of 12.5% and 17.5%, respectively.

The manager is reportedly looking to shift loans from multiple vintages across its Private Markets Credit Strategies and Multi-Asset Credit funds.

Founded in 2007, PennantPark is a mid-market-focused private credit manager with around $10 billion in AUM.
